long_biography.plain_text:
Rocket One Capital became the vehicle through which Michael Shvartsman applied his experience as both entrepreneur and investor to portfolio companies. Its model reaches beyond finance into recruitment, operations, product strategy, partnerships and acquisition planning, with specialists brought in as companies encounter different stages of growth.

Before establishing the investment firm, Shvartsman built and backed businesses in media, advertising technology and financial services. That record included a merchant-processing company sold to Elavon in 2013. The firm's mentorship programme pairs entrepreneurs with experienced operators and advisers who provide guidance on strategy, market challenges and company development.
